Field Descriptions

MPP

Machine Previous Privilege. Hardwired to M (2'b11) — no S/U-mode exists in this core. Read-only constant, writes ignored.

MPIE

Machine Previous Interrupt Enable. HW-updated on trap entry (<= old MIE) and mret (<= 1); HW priority over SW, same as MIE.

MIE

Machine Interrupt Enable. HW-updated on trap entry (cleared) and mret (restored from MPIE); HW write always takes priority over a same-cycle SW write, matching the RTL's if/else-if priority chain.
